observations: Two photos show a white PlayStation 5 console standing upright on a small stand.
The front face has the PlayStation logo; no visible disc drive door details are clear from these angles.
No controller is clearly shown in either photo (only the console front/stand).
No power cable, HDMI cable, ports, serial label, or included accessories are visible.
No model/region markings (e.g., UK/US) are readable in the photos.

claims.claim: Ps5 console fat uk used with 1 pad
claims.evidence: Photos show a PS5 console, but do not show any controller, and do not show any readable region/UK marking or the exact 'fat' variant details.
Photos show a console with minor surface marks, but usage history cannot be confirmed remotely.
No controller is visible in photo 0 or photo 1.
No region/UK-specific label, box, or power/plug marking is readable in the photos.

risks.risk: Controller not included (seller says 1 pad but photos show none).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the included controller(s) next to the console, plus a close-up of the controller model/serial label.

risks.risk: Disc vs Digital edition mismatch (affects value).
risks.proof: Photo showing the disc drive area/slot (or a close-up of the front where the disc door/slot is visible).
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lower value case (assume Digital edition if not clearly shown).

risks.risk: Not working / faulty (seller may claim tested, but no proof here).
risks.proof: Video of the console powering on to the home screen, plus a short game launch and audio/video output.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed working (worst case).

risks.risk: Region/UK version not actually UK (power/region can matter for buyer expectations).
risks.proof: Photo of the console label/serial sticker showing region/model details, or the box label.

risks.risk: Missing parts/accessories (power cable, HDMI, stand, etc.).
risks.proof: Photo of everything included laid out on a surface (power cable, HDMI, controller, manuals/box if any).
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete bundle (only what is shown/assumed minimal).

proof_requests: Clear photo of the included controller (showing it is actually included).
Close-up photo of the front disc drive area to confirm Disc vs Digital edition.
Video proof: console powers on and reaches PS home screen (and ideally loads a game).
Photo of the console serial/model label (for region/variant confirmation).
Photo of all included items laid out (power cable, HDMI, controller, etc.).
response.reason: The photos confirm a PS5 console, but key value drivers are missing: whether a controller is included, whether it’s Disc or Digital, and whether it’s working. Without those, a safe worst-case price can’t be set confidently.
